sourceCitation: Gabrys, R. L., Tabri, N., Anisman, H., & Matheson, K. (2018). Cognitive Control and Flexibility in the Context of Stress and Depressive Symptoms: The Cognitive Control and Flexibility Questionnaire. Frontiers in Psychology, 9, 2219. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2018.02219
changes: 平台中文工作翻译、数字呈现及原创报告；不改变题数、顺序或计分；未获原作者背书。

administration.instructions_en: The purpose of this questionnaire is to determine what you generally think/feel/do when stressful situations provoke negative thoughts and emotions. Of course, you may act differently depending on the situation, but try to think of what you usually think/feel/do when you are stressed or upset. Using the scale below, indicate the extent to which agree or disagree with the following statements.
administration.instructions_zh_working: 这份问卷希望了解：当有压力的情境引起消极的想法和情绪时，你通常会怎么想、怎么感受或怎么做。不同情境下你的反应当然可能不同，但请尽量想一想，当你感到有压力或心烦时，你通常的想法、感受或做法。请使用下面的选项，表示你对以下每句话的同意或不同意程度。
administration.stem_zh_working: 通常，在有压力的情境中……
administration.timeFrame: General/usually; no fixed recent recall period.
administration.intermediateLabels: 2、3、4、5、6仅数字；原文完整中间文字锚点未核实，不补写。
administration.presentationBlocker: 当前ScaleDefinitionV2没有独立指导语/stem字段。此文档并未被runtime读取，#356接入后须显式迁移并核对展示；不将指导语或stem拼进第1题。

items.text_en: I weigh out my options before choosing how to take action.
items.text_zh_working: 我会先权衡可选的办法，再决定如何行动。

items.text_en: I feel like I lose control over my thoughts and emotions.
items.text_zh_working: 我觉得自己失去了对想法和情绪的控制。

items.text_en: I approach the situation from multiple angles.
items.text_zh_working: 我会从多个角度看待这件事。

items.text_en: It’s difficult to let go of intrusive thoughts or emotions.
items.text_zh_working: 我很难放下那些不由自主冒出来的想法或情绪。

items.text_en: I consider the situation for multiple viewpoints before responding.
items.text_zh_working: 在作出回应之前，我会从多个视角考虑这件事。

items.text_en: I take the time to think of several ways to best cope with the situation before acting.
items.text_zh_working: 在行动之前，我会花时间想出几种尽可能妥善应对这件事的办法。

items.text_en: I find it easy to set-aside unpleasant thoughts or emotions.
items.text_zh_working: 我发现自己很容易暂且把令人不快的想法或情绪放到一边。

items.text_en: It is easy for me to ignore distracting thoughts.
items.text_zh_working: 对我来说，不去理会那些分散注意力的想法很容易。

items.text_en: I can easily think of multiple coping options before deciding how to respond.
items.text_zh_working: 在决定如何回应之前，我能很容易地想到多种应对办法。

items.text_en: I take the time to see things from different perspectives before reacting.
items.text_zh_working: 在作出反应之前，我会花时间从不同角度看待事情。

items.text_en: I get easily distracted by upsetting thoughts or feelings.
items.text_zh_working: 令人心烦的想法或感受很容易分散我的注意力。

items.text_en: I take the time to think of more than one way to resolve the problem.
items.text_zh_working: 我会花时间想出不止一种解决问题的办法。

items.text_en: I control my thoughts and feelings by putting the situation into context.
items.text_zh_working: 我会通过把事情放在具体背景中理解，来控制自己的想法和感受。

items.text_en: I can remain in control of my thoughts and emotions.
items.text_zh_working: 我能够保持对自己想法和情绪的控制。

items.text_en: I have a hard time managing my emotions.
items.text_zh_working: 我很难管理自己的情绪。

items.text_en: My thoughts and emotions interfere with my ability to concentrate.
items.text_zh_working: 我的想法和情绪会妨碍我集中注意力。

items.text_en: I manage my thoughts or feelings by reframing the situation.
items.text_zh_working: 我会通过换一种方式理解这件事，来调节自己的想法或感受。

items.text_en: It’s hard for me to shift my attention away from negative thoughts or feelings.
items.text_zh_working: 我很难把注意力从消极的想法或感受上移开。

implementation.missingPolicy: 平台选择各九题完整才计算，不插补；任一题缺失整体quality invalid，不显示解释，另一完整维度数值可能保留。
